fixtures.name: tone-neutral
fixtures.description: A tag in the neutral tone. The Go helper maps the neutral tone to the slate hue and the default variant. On paper it prints as an outline in the hue's text color.

fixtures.name: tone-info
fixtures.description: A tag in the info tone. The Go helper maps the info tone to the blue hue and the default variant. On paper it prints as an outline in the hue's text color.

fixtures.name: tone-success

fixtures.name: tone-warning

fixtures.name: tone-danger
fixtures.description: A tag in the danger tone. The Go helper maps the danger tone to the red hue and the default variant. On paper it prints as an outline in the hue's text color.

fixtures.description: Tags in table cells use the sm size. The table has no classes of its own here.
